program.section_heading: Mobile Equipment Hydraulic Systems Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of this program, the student will be able to apply basic hydraulic theory and principles to practical applications commonly found on mobile equipment.
Upon the successful completion of this program, the student will be able to interpret technical schematics commonly associated with mobile hydraulic systems.
Upon the successful completion of this program, the student will be able to differentiate between the different types of hydraulic components and their correct system applications.

notes: The catalog prints course codes without a space (e.g., MCAGB70NC). These match the closed-list codes MCAG B70NC through MCAG B73NC, so none is marked as a catalog addition.

Hours are printed as '18 - 0', '9 - 0' and the block total as '63 - 0', under the note 'Credits listed are in hours'. The trailing '0' reads as a display artifact of the noncredit unit field, so it is not recorded as a range. The block subheading reads 'Core Courses-63 hours'.
The text says 'To Achieve the Certificate of Achievement' but then awards a Certificate of Completion (noncredit). The heading and award are a Certificate of Completion.

Each program learning outcome begins with its own 'Upon (the) successful completion of this program' phrase. Because that phrase is part of each printed outcome sentence, the outcomes are copied in full.
The career entry is taken from the description's 'area of off-highway equipment hydraulic system repair'. A reviewer should confirm it counts as a career field.
